name: Processing Status 66 Choice
definition: Choice of format for the processing status.

AcknowledgedAccepted.name: Acknowledged Accepted
AcknowledgedAccepted.definition: Instruction has been acknowledged by the account servicer.

Repair.name: Repair
Repair.definition: Instruction or request is accepted but in repair.

Cancelled.name: Cancelled
Cancelled.definition: Instruction has been cancelled. The status on the processing of a cancellation request must be provided using a cancellation request report message.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Specifies a choice of status for the processing of an intra-balance movement.
